## Substitute m = 8 into the formula
U(8) &= 3000(1.8)^8
## Calculate and round to a whole number of users
&\approx 330598.8
&\approx 330599
ANSWER: 330\,599 \text{ users}

## Multiply by 1.8 for one more month
Each extra month multiplies the number of users by $1.8$, because $U(m+1) = 3000(1.8)^{m+1} = 1.8 \times U(m)$.
31493 \times 1.8 &= 56687.4
&\approx 56687
ANSWER: 56\,687 \text{ users}

## Multiply users by the earnings per user
600000 \times 0.0012 &= 720
&= 720
ANSWER: \text{€}720

## Write an equation for the number of users
Let $u$ be the number of users. Earnings = users $\times$ 0.0012.
1285.37 &= 0.0012u
## Divide both sides by 0.0012
u &= \frac{1285.37}{0.0012}
u &\approx 1071141.67
u &\approx 1071142
ANSWER: 1\,071\,142 \text{ users}

## Month 4: find the number of users
U(4) &= 3000(1.8)^4
&= 31492.8
## Month 4: find the income
31492.8 \times 0.0012 &= 37.79136
&\approx 37.79
## Month 4: subtract the €80 cost
37.79 - 80 &= -42.21
The answer is negative, so Avril makes a loss of €42.21 in month 4.
## Month 12: find the number of users
U(12) &= 3000(1.8)^{12}
&\approx 3470494.14
## Month 12: find the income
3470494.144 \times 0.0012 &\approx 4164.59
## Month 12: subtract the €80 cost
4164.59 - 80 &= 4084.59
The answer is positive, so Avril makes a gain of €4084.59 in month 12.
ANSWER: \text{Month 4: loss of €}42.21; \text{ Month 12: gain of €}4084.59

## Divide the pounds by the euros
£55 costs €62.70, so £1 = €$\frac{62.70}{55}$ and €1 = £$\frac{55}{62.70}$.
\text{rate} &= \frac{55}{62.70}
&\approx 0.8772
ANSWER: \text{€}1 = \text{£}0.8772

## Sort the ages by their tens digit
The stem is the tens digit and the leaf is the units digit. Go through the 28 ages in order and put each leaf on its stem.
Stem 1: 18, 19, 18. Stem 2: 21, 21, 22, 20. Stem 3: 32, 35, 33, 34, 39, 33, 34.
Stem 4: 41, 43, 42, 49, 43. Stem 5: 57, 54, 58, 55, 57. Stem 6: 64, 63, 65, 63.
## Write each stem in increasing order
Put the leaves in order, smallest first, on each row.
Check: $3+4+7+5+5+4 = 28$ leaves, one for every employee.
ANSWER: \text{See the completed diagram}

## Count the employees older than 40
No age is exactly 40, so the ages over 40 are every leaf in rows 4, 5 and 6.
5 + 5 + 4 &= 14
## Write as a percentage of 28
\frac{14}{28} \times 100 &= 50\%
ANSWER: 50\%

## Substitute the slope and point P into the line formula
y - y_1 &= m(x - x_1)
y - 2 &= \frac{3}{4}(x - 4)
## Multiply both sides by 4
4(y - 2) &= 3(x - 4)
## Expand the brackets
4y - 8 &= 3x - 12
## Collect every term on one side
0 &= 3x - 4y - 4
ANSWER: 3x - 4y - 4 = 0

## Translate P to the origin
Subtract $(4, 2)$ from every point so that $P$ becomes $(0, 0)$. The area does not change.
P(4, 2) &\to (0, 0)
Q(8, 5) &\to (4, 3)
R(2, 11) &\to (-2, 9)
## Write the area formula for a triangle with a vertex at the origin
\text{Area} &= \frac{1}{2}\left|x_1 y_2 - x_2 y_1\right|
## Substitute $(4, 3)$ and $(-2, 9)$
&= \frac{1}{2}\left|(4)(9) - (-2)(3)\right|
## Evaluate
&= \frac{1}{2}\left|36 + 6\right|
&= \frac{1}{2}(42)
&= 21
ANSWER: 21 \text{ square units}

## Use the complement rule
The probabilities of an event and of its opposite add to 1.
P(\text{not blue}) &= 1 - 0.7
&= 0.3
ANSWER: 0.3

## Multiply, since the two people are independent
P(\text{both blue}) &= 0.7 \times 0.7
&= 0.49
ANSWER: 0.49

## List the ways to get exactly two blue
Write B for blue eyes and N for not blue. The three orders are BBN, BNB and NBB.
## Find the probability of one order
Each order has two blue and one not blue, so each has the same probability.
0.7 \times 0.7 \times 0.3 &= 0.147
## Multiply by the 3 orders
3 \times 0.147 &= 0.441
ANSWER: 0.441

## Find the only order allowed
The first three people are not blue and the fourth is blue: NNNB.
## Multiply the four probabilities
P &= (0.3)^3 \times 0.7
&= 0.027 \times 0.7
&= 0.0189
ANSWER: 0.0189

## Find the translation that takes S to P
$PQRS$ is a square, so $S \to P$ is the same move as $R \to Q$.
S(-4, 11) &\to P(2, 3)
The $x$-co-ordinate goes up by $2 - (-4) = 6$ and the $y$-co-ordinate goes down by $11 - 3 = 8$.
## Apply the same translation to R
R(4, 17) &\to (4 + 6,\ 17 - 8)
&= (10, 9)
ANSWER: Q(10, 9)

## Use the midpoint of the diagonal PR
The centre of the circle is the centre of the square, which is the midpoint of $PR$.
\left(\frac{x_1 + x_2}{2},\ \frac{y_1 + y_2}{2}\right) &= \left(\frac{2 + 4}{2},\ \frac{3 + 17}{2}\right)
## Work out each co-ordinate
x &= \frac{2 + 4}{2}
&= 3
y &= \frac{3 + 17}{2}
&= 10
ANSWER: (3, 10)

## Write the circle equation with centre (3, 10) and radius 5
(x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 &= r^2
(x - 3)^2 + (y - 10)^2 &= 5^2
(x - 3)^2 + (y - 10)^2 &= 25
## Optional: expand into the general form
x^2 - 6x + 9 + y^2 - 20y + 100 &= 25
x^2 + y^2 - 6x - 20y + 84 &= 0
ANSWER: (x - 3)^2 + (y - 10)^2 = 25

## Area of the large disc (radius 3)
A_L &= \pi (3)^2
&= 9\pi
## Area of the removed disc (radius 2.5)
A_S &= \pi (2.5)^2
&= 6.25\pi
## Subtract to get the area of the crescent
A_C &= 9\pi - 6.25\pi
&= 2.75\pi
&\approx 8.64 \text{ cm}^2
## Circumference of the large disc
P_L &= 2\pi r = 2\pi(3)
&= 6\pi
## Circumference of the removed disc
P_S &= 2\pi(2.5)
&= 5\pi
## Add them, since the crescent is bounded by both arcs
P_C &= 6\pi + 5\pi
&= 11\pi
&\approx 34.56 \text{ cm}
ANSWER: \text{Area} = 8.64 \text{ cm}^2, \quad \text{Perimeter} = 34.56 \text{ cm}

## Volume of the cone
V &= \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h
&= \frac{1}{3}\pi (7)^2 (12)
&= \frac{1}{3}\pi (49)(12)
&= \frac{588}{3}\pi
&= 196\pi
&\approx 615.75 \text{ cm}^3
## Convert the flow rate to cm³ per minute
$1$ litre $= 1000\ \text{cm}^3$, so $0.5$ litres $= 500\ \text{cm}^3$ per minute.
## Divide the volume by the rate
t &= \frac{196\pi}{500}
&\approx 1.2315 \text{ minutes}
## Convert minutes to seconds
t &= \frac{196\pi}{500} \times 60
&\approx 73.89 \text{ seconds}
&\approx 74 \text{ seconds}
ANSWER: 74 \text{ seconds}

## Draw [PQ] 9 cm long
Use a ruler to draw $[PQ]$ along the line, 9 cm from the marked point $P$.
## Draw the 65° angle at P
Place the protractor at $P$ with its base on $[PQ]$ and mark 65°. Draw a line through the mark.
## Mark S
Measure 5 cm along this line from $P$ and label the point $S$.
## Find R using two arcs
Opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal, so $|SR| = 9$ cm and $|QR| = 5$ cm.
With the compass at $S$, draw an arc of radius 9 cm. With the compass at $Q$, draw an arc of radius 5 cm. They cross at $R$.
## Join up the parallelogram
Join $S$ to $R$ and $Q$ to $R$ and label the parallelogram $PQRS$. Keep all arcs and labels.
ANSWER: PQRS \text{ with } |PQ|=|SR|=9,\ |PS|=|QR|=5,\ \angle SPQ = 65^\circ

## Use the area formula with the sine of the included angle
Area of a parallelogram $= ab\sin C$, with the two sides 9 and 5 and the angle 65° between them.
\text{Area} &= ab\sin C
&= 9(5)\sin 65^\circ
&= 45(0.906307787)
&\approx 40.78385042
&\approx 40.78 \text{ cm}^2
ANSWER: 40.78 \text{ cm}^2

## Find α
$|OW| = |OY|$ because they are radii, so triangle $OWY$ is isosceles.
The angles opposite equal sides are equal, so the angle at $Y$ equals the angle at $W$.
\alpha &= 52
## Find the angle YOW
Angles in a triangle add to 180°.
|\angle YOW| &= 180 - 52 - 52
&= 76
## Find the angle YOX
$W$, $O$ and $X$ lie on a straight line, so angles $YOW$ and $YOX$ add to 180°.
|\angle YOX| &= 180 - 76
&= 104
## Find β
$|OY| = |OX|$ because they are radii, so the two base angles of triangle $OYX$ are equal.
2\beta &= \frac{180 - 104}{2}
2\beta &= 38
\beta &= 19
ANSWER: \alpha = 52,\ \beta = 19

## Find the maximum, minimum and range for Fish
\text{Maximum} &= 177
\text{Minimum} &= 59
\text{Range} &= 177 - 59
&= 118
## Find the maximum, minimum and range for Milk, Cheese and Eggs
\text{Maximum} &= 175
\text{Minimum} &= 65
\text{Range} &= 175 - 65
&= 110
## Find the maximum, minimum and range for Fruits, Vegetables and Potatoes
\text{Maximum} &= 172
\text{Minimum} &= 48
\text{Range} &= 172 - 48
&= 124
ANSWER: \text{Fish } 177, 59, 118;\ \text{Milk } 175, 65, 110;\ \text{Fruit } 172, 48, 124

## Write the data in increasing order
Take the Fruits, Vegetables and Potatoes column and list the 13 values from smallest to largest.
\text{Ordered} &: 48, 62, 77, 86, 95, 104, 111, 116, 125, 136, 137, 150, 172
## Find the position of the median
With 13 values the median is the middle one.
\frac{13 + 1}{2} &= \frac{14}{2}
&= 7
The median is the 7th value in the ordered list.
## Read off the median
\text{Median} &= 111
ANSWER: \text{Median} = 111

## Add all 13 Meat values
\text{Sum} &= 132 + 117 + 106 + 63 + 56 + 111 + 157 + 54 + 85 + 131 + 254 + 78 + 112
&= 1456
## Divide by the number of countries
There are 13 countries.
\text{Mean} &= \frac{1456}{13}
&= 112
ANSWER: \text{€}112

## Use the calculator in statistics mode
Enter the 13 Meat values into the calculator and read off the population standard deviation $\sigma$.
\sigma &\approx 50.99
&\approx 51
ANSWER: \text{€}51

## Find the interval within one standard deviation
Add and subtract the standard deviation from the mean.
112 - 51 &= 61
112 + 51 &= 163
So the interval is $[61, 163]$.
## List the countries outside the interval
Meat values below 61 are Macedonia (56) and Poland (54). The value above 163 is Switzerland (254).
ANSWER: \text{Macedonia, Poland and Switzerland}

## Use the price index to convert each cost
The same items cost in proportion to the price index. Divide the Irish cost by the Irish index, then multiply by the Polish index.
## Work out the Polish cost of Fish
\text{Poland} &= \frac{31.32}{108} \times 64
&= 0.29 \times 64
&= 18.56
## Work out the Polish cost of Milk, Cheese and Eggs
\text{Poland} &= \frac{24.32}{128} \times 65
&= 0.19 \times 65
&= 12.35
## Work out the Polish cost of Fruits, Vegetables and Potatoes
\text{Poland} &= \frac{31.28}{136} \times 62
&= 0.23 \times 62
&= 14.26
## Add the four Polish costs
\text{Total} &= 18.36 + 18.56 + 12.35 + 14.26
&= 63.53
ANSWER: \text{Fish } 18.56;\ \text{Milk } 12.35;\ \text{Fruit } 14.26;\ \text{Total } 63.53

## Substitute r = 3 into the sphere formula
V &= \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3
&= \frac{4}{3}\pi (3)^3
&= \frac{4}{3}\pi (27)
&= 36\pi
ANSWER: 36\pi \text{ cm}^3

## Find the curved surface area
The cylinder has $r = 5$ and $h = 18$.
\text{CSA} &= 2\pi r h
&= 2\pi (5)(18)
&= 180\pi
## Find the area of the rectangle
\text{Area} &= 35 \times 20
&= 700
## Subtract to find what is left
\text{Left over} &= 700 - 180\pi
&\approx 700 - 565.49
&\approx 134.51
&\approx 134.5 \text{ cm}^2
ANSWER: 134.5 \text{ cm}^2

## Substitute n = 800 into the margin of error formula
\text{Margin of error} &= \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}
&= \frac{1}{\sqrt{800}}
&\approx 0.035355
## Write as a percentage
Multiply by 100 and round to 2 decimal places.
&\approx 3.5355\%
&\approx 3.54\%
ANSWER: 3.54\%

## Find the sample proportion
\hat{p} &= \frac{350}{800}
&= 0.4375
&= 43.75\%
## Add and subtract the margin of error
The 95% confidence interval is $\hat{p} \pm \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}}$, with margin of error 3.54%.
\text{Lower} &= 43.75 - 3.54
&= 40.21
\text{Upper} &= 43.75 + 3.54
&= 47.29
ANSWER: 40.21\% < p < 47.29\%

## State the hypotheses
H_0 &: \text{the level of support is } 50\%
H_1 &: \text{the level of support is not } 50\%
## Compare 50% with the confidence interval
The 95% confidence interval from part (ii) is $[40.21\%, 47.29\%]$.
50\% &\notin [40.21\%, 47.29\%]
## State the conclusion and reason
Reason: 50% is not inside the 95% confidence interval, so there is not enough evidence to support the newspaper claim.
Conclusion: reject $H_0$. The level of support for abolishing daylight saving time in the area is not 50%.
ANSWER: \text{Reject } H_0:\ 50\% \notin [40.21\%, 47.29\%]

## Apply Pythagoras in triangle QRS
The right angle is at $Q$, so $[RS]$ is the hypotenuse with $|RS| = 100$ (the radius), and $|RQ| = 60$.
|RS|^2 &= |RQ|^2 + |QS|^2
100^2 &= 60^2 + |QS|^2
10000 &= 3600 + |QS|^2
## Solve for |QS|
|QS|^2 &= 10000 - 3600
&= 6400
|QS| &= \sqrt{6400}
&= 80
ANSWER: |QS| = 80 \text{ km}

## Apply Pythagoras in triangle PQR
$|PR| = 120$ is the hypotenuse and $|QR| = 60$.
|PR|^2 &= |QR|^2 + |PQ|^2
120^2 &= 60^2 + |PQ|^2
14400 &= 3600 + |PQ|^2
|PQ|^2 &= 14400 - 3600
&= 10800
## Find |PQ|
|PQ| &= \sqrt{10800}
&\approx 103.92
## Subtract |QS| to find |PS|
$S$ lies between $P$ and $Q$, so $|PS| = |PQ| - |QS|$.
|PS| &= 103.92 - 80
&= 23.92
&\approx 24 \text{ km}
ANSWER: |PS| \approx 24 \text{ km}

## Find |TS|
$Q$ is the foot of the perpendicular from the centre $R$ to the chord $[ST]$, so it is the midpoint of $[ST]$.
|TS| &= 2|QS|
&= 2 \times 80
&= 160
## Substitute into the cosine rule
In triangle $RST$: $|RS| = |RT| = 100$ and $|TS| = 160$, with $\theta$ opposite $[TS]$.
|TS|^2 &= |RT|^2 + |RS|^2 - 2|RT||RS|\cos\theta
160^2 &= 100^2 + 100^2 - 2(100)(100)\cos\theta
25600 &= 20000 - 20000\cos\theta
## Solve for cos θ
20000\cos\theta &= 20000 - 25600
20000\cos\theta &= -5600
\cos\theta &= -\frac{5600}{20000}
&= -\frac{7}{25}
## Find θ using inverse cosine
\theta &= \cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{7}{25}\right)
&\approx 106.26^\circ
&\approx 106^\circ
ANSWER: \cos\theta = -\frac{7}{25},\ \theta = 106^\circ
